summary: This clinical trial compares a new drug called SHR-3167 to another treatment named insulin degludec in adults with type 2 diabetes. Type 2 diabetes is a condition where the body does not use insulin properly to control blood sugar. The study will look at 680 participants who are currently treated with basal insulin, which is a long-acting form of insulin. Jiangsu HengRui Medicine Co., Ltd. is sponsoring this Phase 3 trial.
